target.title: fix(skills): surface skill source shadowing
target.body:
Closes #100071

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users could have a workspace skill silently replace a same-named plugin, bundled, managed, or agent skill without any visible signal in skill discovery, the CLI, Control UI, or doctor lint.

## Why This Change Was Made

This keeps the existing documented precedence behavior, but records lower-precedence same-name skill sources as shadow metadata on the active skill. The metadata is surfaced in load-time warnings, `openclaw skills list` / `openclaw skills info`, Control UI skill cards/details, and the skills-readiness doctor lint check. This intentionally does not add a fail-closed `denyShadowing` config surface because that compatibility/security policy still needs maintainer product/security direction.

## User Impact

Operators can now see when an active skill is overriding another skill source and inspect the shadowed paths before deciding whether the override is intentional. Existing intentional overrides continue to work.

## Evidence

- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/skills/loading/workspace-precedence.test.ts src/skills/discovery/status.test.ts src/cli/skills-cli.test.ts src/flows/doctor-core-checks.test.ts src/flows/doctor-core-checks.e2e.test.ts`
  - Result: passed 3 Vitest shards, 64 tests passed, 1 skipped, in 60.40s on head `92945133b3db90910b6f43b76f63c90b9f43459e`.
- Commit hook oxfmt ran on the 15 staged files: `Finished in 1309ms on 15 files using 20 threads.`
- Autoreview local mode completed with exit code 0.

Not tested / proof gaps:
- `ui/src/pages/skills/view.test.ts` could not run in this temporary worktree because the available local dependency tree is missing `@openclaw/uirouter`; the changed UI behavior is covered by the added rendering test and should run in CI's hydrated dependency environment.
- Crabbox/Testbox remote proof was unavailable locally because the configured Crabbox binary failed provider/version sanity checks with `version=unknown provider=blacksmith-testbox providers=unknown`.
